comment: A tool call's public name: the key a host registers its own card under, and the name the agent's tool list, hooks and the console show. A connected server's tool is `mcp__<server>__<tool>` (the runner's mcpToolName, backend/services/runner/src/shared/mcp-tool-names.ts); a call the kit draws as its own kind (a built-in, the memory attachment's tools, a server tool named like a built-in) has none, written as null. Asserted by the runner's mcp-tool-names tests (writer side, the cases with a name) and the @stigmer/client tool-view tests (reader side, toolPublicName).
